### Findings refused or left

- Unit 2 weaving terms (ቄፋዝ ዝብጦ ወእኑም ዘሜላት), unit 3 አናጹት, unit 4 ደረ, unit 21 ትሕቢት, unit 22 ምስካይ, unit 25 ቃማ, unit 31 ጽግነት, እምአብያጺሁ: unresolvable without Dillmann; the drafter's (?) and left-untranslated treatment is kept. ቃማ may be related to ቆማ "height" (ch. 45) but that is not strong enough to change anything.
- Unit 4 "as Moses was commanded" for ዘተአዘዞ ለሙሴ: ተአዘዘ "was commanded" has house precedent (ch. 42, 46–48; ch. 13–16 has "obeyed"); kept.
- Unit 5 ወአስተጋብኦን could be 3ms perfect "he gathered them" as well as imperative; the following imperative ወሰድ decides it for the imperative; no change.
- Unit 18 አስተብፅዐ "gave praise (?)": kept, hedged by the drafter.
- Unit 22 የሀቦ person shift (2ms/3ms): kept as flagged in the note.
- Unit 31 ያነውኃ "makes it sail": plausible from context, root not verifiable; left unhedged because the sense (wind driving a ship) is secure.
- Allusions checked: Exodus 28:33–35 (bells), 1 Samuel 6:4–5 (golden tumours and mice), 1 Samuel 2:27–30 and 3:11–14 (Eli), Exodus 23:13 (names of other gods), 1 Kings 8:44, 48 (prayer toward the city), Numbers 35 (cities of refuge, hedged), 1 Samuel 10:1, Exodus 13:21 and 14:21–22, Psalm 105:39 (Hebrew numbering, as the house cites Psalm 74:2). All correct as cited.
- `t`, `p`, the title, `part` and `about` are unchanged; units are all within the length rule (unit 10, 36 words, is the longest).
